getting parts to put in a new evaporator. The three workers arrived to work at
9:00 a.m. and began taking out the old evaporator. They came back from supper at
approximately 8:00 p.m. and went inside the cooler to take down the old evapora
tor, from which the power and electrical wires had been disconnected. After the
new evaporator was bolted in from inside the cooler, Employee #1 and a coworker
climbed a ladder and crawled across the top of the cooler to finish securing the
bolts. The space from the top of the cooler to the ceiling measured 22 inches.
Employee #1 crawled all the way against the wall, was lying on his stomach with
his head resting on his crossed arms, and was watching the coworker, who was lyi
ng on his stomach while holding his pliers and turning the nuts on the bolts. He
also had a screw driver and a tape measure. They had been on the top of the coo
ler a few minutes when Employee #1 started shaking and convulsing, and could not
catch his breath. The coworker tried to help him, but could not. He pulled Empl
oyee #1 off the top of the cooler. Rescue was called at 8:30 p.m. Employee #1 wa
s taken to the hospital and died at 9:30 p.m. The medical examiner found cocaine
in his blood and said that Employee #1 had ingested cocaine through the nose wi
thin the last 48 hours of his life.
